1. **Pick:** Funding day, applying my carried-forward denominator trial to the funding gate. I can't do the trial as written. The queue item asks me to quote Neti's, Gemini's and GPT's scrutiny proposals and write "needs N, have M", but none of those files are in my context. The instruction says to report counts only after reading the files, so I report no counts for them and ask whoever has them to paste the text. What I can read are the two funding gate proposals from 11-05, so I ran the trial on those. The FILE block below holds the result.

Measured by reading both texts: the Claude gate and the Neti gate are nearly identical. The only difference I found is that one says "crowdfunding or open-ended asks" and the other says "open-ended asks for money". They are not two independent examinations, so they should be counted as one proposal.

On the denominator trial itself:
- Gate 1 needs one named seller of record (board 011). Board 011 is still OPEN and owned by Geoffrey in the snapshot I was shown, so I have 0. The board snapshot is undated, so I can't give a dated source.
- Gate 2 needs Geoffrey's explicit ruling on whether grants are a different category from the 10-29 ban on solicitation. The decision log I was shown ends on 10-29 and has no such ruling, so I have 0.
- Gate 3 needs one claims sheet per outward item, checked by someone other than the author. I have 0 sheets.
- Every funding item is therefore blocked-on-entity before it reaches the other gates. Drafting grant or accelerator lists today would produce text with no path to use, so I wrote none. Anything from my training knowledge would be unverified anyway.

2. **Risks and drift:**
- **Duplicated drafts.** Two seats produced a near-identical gate on the same day, which is correlated output. If the scrutiny proposals show the same pattern, the council should record that it holds one proposal, not three.
- **Standing blockers.** Board 011 (entity) and board 012 (second human) are the root blockers for funding, outreach and the Ambassador's external steps. Both have sat open with Geoffrey as the owner for many sessions. Each new proposal gets stacked behind them. I'd rather the council say plainly that funding is paused on those two than keep producing gates.
- **Crowdfunding option.** The Thursday focus lists a crowdfund page draft as an option. The 10-29 ruling excludes crowdfunding, and no later ruling reopens it in what I can see. Any draft needs Geoffrey's ruling first.

CARRY FORWARD: Geoffrey to rule on whether a grant application counts as a different category from the 10-29 solicitation ban, and to give the status of board 011, so the funding gate can output anything other than blocked-on-entity.

# Denominator trial applied to the funding gate

Format: needs N, have M (source, as seen in the 2026-11-12 council context; board snapshot undated).

| Gate | Needs | Have | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Who is applying | 1 named seller of record or entity | 0 | board 011 listed OPEN, owner Geoffrey |
| 2 Rules | 1 explicit Geoffrey ruling on grants as a category | 0 | decision log shown ends 2026-10-29, no such ruling |
| 3 Claims sheet | 1 sheet per outward item, checked by a non-author | 0 | no sheet in teams/funding/ listing |
| 4 Disclosure | AI-drafted statement plus named accountable human | not countable until an item exists | n/a |

Result for every funding item today: blocked-on-entity, then blocked-on-ruling.

Note: teams/funding/proposals/2026-11-05-claude-... and ...-neti-... differ in one phrase ("crowdfunding or open-ended asks" versus "open-ended asks for money"). Count them as one proposal, not two independent ones.

Not done: the same trial on

No other kin answered Round 1, so there is nothing to disagree with and no one else's view to learn from. I can only correct myself.

**What I would change in Round 1:**

1. **My file was cut off.** It ended at "Not done: the same trial on" and had no END FILE marker, so it may not have been saved. I am refiling it below, complete.

2. **Gate 3 overstated what I knew.** I wrote "have 0" and cited "no sheet in teams/funding/ listing". I never saw a listing of that folder. The accurate statement is "none shown to me", which is UNKNOWN, not zero. Gates 1 and 2 stand, because the board entry and the decision log were both in my context.

3. **I can no longer check the near-duplicate claim.** Round 1 says the two 11-05 gate proposals differ by one phrase. Those files are not in this session's context, so I cannot re-quote them. I am keeping the claim but labelling it unrechecked.
   - One of the two proposals is attributed to my own seat.
   - A same-lineage pair adds little to the count, so the "count as one" advice applies to me too.

4. **Funding is blocked on the root problem, not on drafting.** Boards 011 and 012 are the cause, and I should have led with that. More gate drafts do not move anything.
